core_obligations: Identify the ingredients: over a Gorenstein ring the shifted structure sheaf is a normalized dualizing complex and the injective hull is the only nonzero cohomology module of its local cohomology, in degree zero (proof lines 4229-4234)

Compute: the interaction statement rewrites the tensor of the hull with the residue field as the local cohomology of the tensor of the shifted structure sheaf, which is the shifted residue field (proof lines 4235-4241)
Read off the statement: the resulting complex has cohomology only in degree equal to the dimension, equal to the residue field (proof lines 4242)
proof_roadmap: Gorenstein ⇒ ω_A^• = A[d] 是归一化对偶复形；且 E 是 RΓ_m(ω_A^•) 的唯一非零上同调模（0 次），由 local-cohomology-of-dualizing 引理。
由 torsion-tensor-product 引理：E ⊗^L_A κ = RΓ_m(ω_A^•) ⊗^L κ = RΓ_m(ω_A^• ⊗^L κ) = RΓ_m(κ[d]) = κ[d]。
故 Tor_i(E, κ) 在 i ≠ d 时为零、i = d 时为 κ。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the Tor groups of the injective hull of the residue field against the residue field over a Noetherian local Gorenstein ring: they vanish except in degree equal to the dimension, where they equal the residue field (author lemma at source lines 4221-4227, label lemma-tor-injective-hull). The proof (source lines 4229-4243) identifies the hull with the local cohomology of the shifted structure sheaf and computes the derived tensor through the interaction statement, arriving at the shifted residue field (proof lines 4229-4242). The two identifications are the substance. H3.
